artworks.title: Faust
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on a heavy white paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of W.G. Russell Allen
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man from the waist up. He is leaning forward slightly with one hand resting on a table and the other hand partially obscured. His face has wrinkles, and he has a long beard. He is wearing a turban, a heavy robe with distinct patterns, and is inside a room with a window behind him. On the table are papers and tools. In the background, there are heavy shadows and the window streams light, highlighting a circular symbol.

artworks.title: Jan Lutma
artworks.medium: etching, engraving and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of W.G. Russell Allen
artworks.description: The image depicts an older man seated in a chair. He is leaning slightly to his left, with his right arm on the armrest and his left arm on his lap. The man has a kind expression, with pronounced cheekbones, a smile, and a full beard. He wears a cap covering his short gray hair, a long robe over a buttoned coat. The chair has ornate carvings on the backrest. The man holds a small object in his right hand. The background shows a large window with grid-like panes, with a ceramic jar and a decorative figure on the windowsill. The setting suggests an interior space with textured walls and furniture.

artworks.title: Jan Asselijn
artworks.creditLine: Gift of W.G. Russell Allen
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a seated man turned slightly to the side, but facing forward. He has long, curly hair that falls past his shoulders and a slight mustache, with defined facial features visible in the etching. He is wearing a wide-brimmed hat and a dark cloak over a tunic that features a white collar with lace cuffs. His right hand rests on a book that is part of a small stack placed on a table in front of him, which includes a few other books and papers. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Artist's Mother Seated at a Table, Looking Right
artworks.creditLine: Gift of W.G. Russell Allen
artworks.description: The image shows an older woman in a seated position with her hands folded on her lap. She has a furrowed brow and prominent cheekbones, with her hair covered by a dark, hood-like garment framing her face. She is wearing a heavy, textured shawl or cloak over her shoulders, with a lighter garment peeking out around the neck and wrists. There are no visible pieces of jewelry. The background is simple, emphasizing the person's form and clothing against a blank canvas.

artworks.title: Peasant in a Round Hat (Paysan avec chapeau rond)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is an etched portrait of a person, shown from the head to the upper torso in a three-quarter view. The individual has a prominent nose, deep-set eyes looking downward to their left, and a somber expression. They wear a wide-brimmed hat that mostly conceals their hair. The attire is simple and blends into the background. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by the person. The background is plain with sketchy lines framing the portrait. Inscriptions of "A.L" in the top left corner and a signature "A. Legros" in the bottom right corner are present.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Death: After the Battle (Le triomphe de la mort: Apres le combat)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a skeletal figure riding a horse over a field of fallen figures. The scene is depicted in a dark monochrome palette with intricate cross-hatching techniques emphasizing the shadows and textures. The central figure is skeletal, cloaked, and holds a spear while riding a powerful horse. Below them are scattered bodies, twisted as if felled in battle. The lines in the artwork give a sense of movement and drama, creating an otherworldly and tumultuous atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Tree of Salvation (L'arbre de salut)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: Two individuals are kneeling on the ground, facing away from the viewer. They are looking towards a large tree with papers or signs nailed to it. They wear traditional clothing and headscarves, and there are a basket and clogs beside them. The background shows a sketchy landscape with a barren tree and branches.

artworks.title: Siesta of a Harvester (Sieste d'un faucheur)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image features a man laying on a grassy area with a scythe beside him. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing a flat landscape with trees and a building in the distance. The artwork is done in an etching style with fine lines to depict texture and form. The color scheme is monochromatic with blacks, greys against a light beige background, creating a serene mood.

artworks.title: Remembrance of a Valley in Bourgogne (Souvenir d'une vallee en Bourgogne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a child sitting near a tree on the left and another figure working in the center surrounded by foliage. In the background, there are distant hills and structures suggesting a town or cityscape. The etched lines are detailed with cross-hatching defining the landscape and figures. The color palette is monochrome with gray and brown tones. The scene conveys a sense of depth and texture, with a classic and serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Little Burner of Grass (Le petit bruleur d'herbe)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on very light green paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed etched scene featuring a large, gnarled tree with intricate roots and foliage. Next to the tree, a figure is kneeling by a low wall, while in the distance, there is a stone building with a chimney. The landscape is filled with vegetation and natural elements, depicted in a monochromatic color palette with meticulous pen strokes.

artworks.title: Peat-bogs (Les Tourbieres)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with trees and shrubs, viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is low, emphasizing the sky above. The vegetation varies from dense to more sparse as it recedes into the distance. The brushstrokes create detailed textures. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of sepia or dark brown. The technique emphasizes contrast and detail through light and shadow.

artworks.title: Plain near a Lake (La plaine pres du lac)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image features an elevated point of view over a rural landscape. The horizon is high, with hills in the distance. The artwork includes fine etching strokes for detail and texture. The scene shows fields with cross-hatching and trees throughout. In the distance, a rolling countryside with structures and trees can be seen. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of beige, giving a timeless quality to the image.

artworks.title: Farm along the River seen by Evening Light (La ferme sur la riviere: Effet du soir)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with two figures working in a field near a thatched-roof farmhouse by a body of water. Surrounding the house are dense foliage and tall trees, leading to open fields in the distance. The sky above is empty. The artwork features fine cross-hatching and delicate strokes in a monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: Valley in Bourgogne (Une vallee en Bourgogne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view of a landscape with hills in the distance, detailed linework capturing foliage and terrain, trees framing the sides, shrubs leading to a cluster of buildings, and a monochromatic color palette created with varying intensities of black ink.

artworks.title: Valley in Bourgogne (Une vallee en Bourgogne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a vast landscape with trees, a winding river or road, and rustic buildings with smoke rising from chimneys. The foreground has detailed trees and foliage framing the edges, and the landscape is mostly monochromatic in shades of sepia. The overall scene conveys a vintage and tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Edge of the Water (Au bord de l'eau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a dense woodland scene with a perspective from a slightly elevated view. The clearing between the trees is visible, surrounded by vertical tree trunks and lush foliage. The detailed etching style features fine lines and soft shading to depict textures of the trees and leaves. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of brown and gray. A small tree with leaves is in the foreground, while taller trees are visible in the distance, creating a sense of depth. The background gradually fades into lighter tones, emphasizing the center of the composition.

artworks.title: Near the Woods, Veronne (Pres du bois, Veronne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a nature scene from a slightly elevated perspective, showing a dense forest area with no visible horizon line. The forest is filled with large, mature trees with textured bark and abundant foliage, creating an enclosed and deep space. The art style features detailed line work capturing the shapes of leaves and branches. The color palette is black and white, giving a classic appearance to the scene. Intricate linear patterns and crosshatching add texture and depth to the landscape, with more trees and shrubs visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Hurricane (L'ouragan)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heavily wooded landscape. The drawing depicts several tall, gnarled trees with large twisting trunks and branches dominating the scene. The forest appears dense with detailed bark and foliage. The landscape conveys age and mystery, characterized by lines and shading that create depth and texture. The ground is uneven and covered with underbrush. The sky in the background is filled with swirling clouds.

artworks.title: Small Boat in Peril (Barque en peril)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures positioned along the left edge, with the viewpoint situated slightly behind and above them. The background features swirling lines representing waves and sky, with a barely discernible horizon. The finely detailed brushstrokes create texture and movement, especially in the water and clothing. The monochromatic palette of varying shades of gray intensifies the scene's drama, contrasting the figures with the turbulent environment. A solitary figure in the distance struggles in the waves, conveying a feeling of openness and vulnerability against the vast sea.

artworks.title: Little Shelter (Le petit hangar)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a thatched-roof structure surrounded by trees. A person is visible on a dirt path leading to the structure. In the distance, there is a village with faint suggestions of buildings and a church. The scene is rendered in detailed, intricate line work typical of etching, with a monochrome color palette of sepia and black.

artworks.title: Banks of the Somme near Amiens (Bord de la Somme pres d'Amiens)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This image depicts a landscape with a small body of water and a figure boating. The scene includes trees, a horizon line, and a monochromatic color palette of earthy tones. The artwork is executed with fine-lined etching techniques, creating intricate textures. A figure is seen boating on the water while trees frame the composition.

artworks.title: Footbridge (La passerelle)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a footbridge over a stream, vegetation, a figure on a rock, thatched roofs, and a conical-roofed structure in the distance. The setting includes rolling hills and trees, depicted in sepia tones with detailed textures and fine brushstrokes emphasizing light and shadow.

artworks.title: Rest along the Banks of the River (Repos au bord de la riviere)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a view from within a grove of trees, looking towards a riverbank. In the foreground, there are tall trees framing the scene, leading the eye towards two figures near the river. The horizon is created by the river's edge and distant trees, adding depth to the composition. The style resembles delicate etching, with fine lines detailing the foliage and figures. The monochromatic color palette in soft sepia tones creates a tranquil atmosphere. In the distance, the river flows gently through the landscape, surrounded by lush vegetation, capturing a moment of calm nature.

artworks.title: Hamlet near the Lake (Le hameau pres du lac)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a high horizon line. The artwork features delicate and finely detailed brushstrokes or etching lines showing trees, foliage, and a building in the distance. The color palette is monochromatic in varying shades of sepia or earthy tones. In the foreground, a figure can be seen working with a tool, obscured by grass and bushes. The landscape is filled with trees of different sizes, leading towards a distant horizon with a structure nestled among them. The sky is lightly etched in the background, creating a sense of open space.
